page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.8xlarge is a storage-optimized instance type designed for workloads requiring substantial local storage capacity and balanced compute resources. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core. A key characteristic of this instance is its integrated 3839 GB local SSD storage, which is bundled directly with the server. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities but weak single-core performance. The single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression is poor, placing in the bottom 10%. However, the instance leverages its 32 physical cores to achieve average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the middle 50% tier, with read-only small block cached speeds reaching 1310.12 GB/sec and uncached large block writes at 43.49 GB/sec.

Given the combination of a large 3839 GB local SSD and average multi-threaded performance, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for storage-heavy workloads that do not demand high single-threaded CPU speeds. It is well-suited for database operations, as reflected in its average Passmark database and Redis SET benchmark results. Other appropriate workloads include static web serving, multi-threaded decompression tasks, and moderate-scale LLM inference prompt processing. It is less suitable for single-threaded applications or high-performance computing tasks that rely heavily on single-core execution speeds.

It is best suited for database operations, static web serving, and multi-threaded data processing, while being less optimal for single-threaded tasks.
